name: plainspoken
description: Write like a person, not an AI: anti-AI-tells engine with isolated judges, voice profiles, plain language, claims integrity and built-in kaizen.

interface.shortDescription: Check and fix AI writing tells, in your own voice
interface.longDescription: plainspoken checks a draft for AI writing tells with a fixed lint and four isolated judges, removes what it finds without adding facts, and helps you write, simplify and fact-check in a voice profile. Read hosts/codex.md for how it runs in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Check this draft for AI writing tells.
Make this sound less like ChatGPT wrote it.
